subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the sister of B’,

A @ B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A − B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

and A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is O related to V if ‘O @ P − T # G + V’?
solution:

Given: O @ P − T # G + V

It means: O is the brother of P, P is the wife of T, T is the father of G, G is the sister of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df51084d1e06b4094a39cc76e153bca2bb6d555aa2c5fabbf77a9d970ce1846c.png] 

Thus, O is V's Mother's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
